entries.text: I traced the renderer entrypoint through the view registry, navigation shell, timeline projector, row projector, and transcript renderer. I checked how each layer handles persisted messages, live stream events, tool lifecycle states, approval gaps, narrow viewport behavior, focus restoration, reduced motion, and terminal recovery. I also compared the production script order with the test harness order, reviewed the ownership boundaries around Electron persistence and the sidecar protocol, and confirmed that the final answer can remain concise because the detailed evidence is retained in the collapsed reasoning summary.
